title: Forward input-copying run
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word. For every $j$ with $0\le j\le |x|$, after $j$ steps from the copier configuration with input head at position $1$, empty work tape, and work head at $0$, the machine is in its copying control with input head at position $j+1$, the first $j$ bits of $x$ copied onto the work tape, and work head at position $j$.
replaced: For every input word $x$ and every $j \le |x|$, running the input copier for $j$ steps from its start configuration copies exactly the first $j$ bits of $x$ onto the work buffer, with the input head at position $j + 1$ and the work head at $j$; every source read and target write is charged.
